Middle column: 3 hidden units, each a light-green (#90EE90) box containing the Sigma symbol 'Σ' followed by a pale-yellow (#FFFACD) box containing a sigmoid-like activation glyph; the label 'Net' sits above each. Right column: 3 output units in the same Σ+activation style, labeled 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output 3' to their right. Further right: text labels 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'. Far right: vertical red (#FF0000) bar with 'Error' written three times vertically. Blue (#0000FF) arrows connect every input to every hidden unit (9 arrows) and every hidden unit to every output unit (9 arrows). Bottom of diagram: 'Input' label with an upward arrow, a green (#008000) circle containing '1', a purple/pink circle containing '?', and the 'Neural Net' label at bottom-left. Small green (#008000) upward arrows appear near the bottom (exact count not specified in source).
